name: JobTread
summary: Estimating, budgeting, proposals, scheduling and project tracking for small and mid-size contractors.
differentiator: There are no feature tiers. Every plan has every feature, and the price follows internal users only: a $199 per month base with one user included and $20 for each user from 2 to 10 ($16 on annual billing). Customers, vendors and subs get free portal access, so inviting 30 subs to quote does not raise the bill.
pricing: $199 per month base with one internal user included. Additional internal users: $20 each for 2 to 10, $15 for 11 to 20, $10 for 21 to 30 and $5 beyond; annual billing is about 20 percent less. No setup fees or contract, no free trial, and a 30-day money-back guarantee on monthly plans.
whoPays: Subscriber pays; base fee plus per internal user
bestFor: Contractors who want to control cost by headcount, not by feature tier.
skipIf: You want a free trial before paying.
